data.name: Cyrene
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Cyrene was a nymph who helped the dying god Dionysus by carrying him on her back to the land where he could be revived. In the New Testament, Cyrene is the name of a city in modern-day Libya where Simon of Cyrene helped carry the cross for Jesus.
data.spiritual_meaning: Offering help and support when needed.

in_hebrew.name: סירנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סירנה הוא מקורו ביוונית ומתייחס לעיר עתיקה באפריקה הצפונית, כיום מרוקו. בעברית, השם משויך לאחד המקומות במסעותיו של השליח פאולוס. הוא נושא קונוטציות של עיר חשובה בדרכים הצפוניות-אפריקאיות.

in_greek.name: Κυρήνη
in_greek.meaning: πόλις ἐν Λιβύη, ἀρχαία και σημαντική
in_greek.long_meaning: Κυρήνη, η πόλις εν Λιβύη, ήτο αρχαία και σημαντική πόλις της ρωμαϊκής επαρχίας της Κρήτης και Κυρηναϊκής. Στη Καινή Διαθήκη, αναφέρεται ως τόπος καταγωγής του Σίμων του Κυρηναίου, που βοήθησε τον Ιησού να φέρει το σταυρό.

in_latin.name: Cyrene
in_latin.meaning: ancient city in Libya, significant stop
in_latin.long_meaning: Cyrene, an ancient city in the Roman province of Creta et Cyrenaica, located in modern-day Libya. It was a significant urban center in North Africa during the Roman era. In Christian tradition, Cyrene is noted as the hometown of Simon of Cyrene, who assisted Jesus in carrying the cross.

in_english.name: Cyrene
in_english.meaning: Ancient city in Libya, Simon's hometown
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cyrene originates from the Greek city in Libya, Cyrene, which was an essential stop on the Mediterranean routes. In Christian tradition, it's notably the hometown of Simon of Cyrene, who helped Jesus carry the cross (Matthew 27:32, Mark 15:21, Luke 23:26). The name carries connotations of assistance, strength, and historical significance within Christian narratives.

biblical_reference.note: City in Libya, hometown of Simon who helped Jesus

data.cultural_impact: The name "Cyrene" holds a rich and intriguing cultural significance, connecting it to both Greek mythology and the New Testament of the Christian Bible. In Greek mythology, Cyrene was a nymph who showed great compassion and strength by carrying the dying god Dionysus on her back to a land where he could be revived. This act of kindness and selflessness is a powerful representation of the importance of helping others in times of need.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Cyrene" holds a deeply spiritual significance, representing the compassionate and selfless spirit of the Greek nymph Cyrene and the strong faith demonstrated by Simon of Cyrene in carrying the cross for Jesus. The name Cyrene serves as a reminder of the importance of helping others, showing kindness and compassion, and having faith in the face of adversity. It is a name that embodies the values of selflessness, strength, and compassion, making it a powerful and meaningful choice for those seeking to honor these values in their own lives.

historical_references.reference: The city of Cyrene was a Greek colony founded in the 7th century BC on the north coast of Libya. It was named after the Phoenician goddess Cyrene, who was believed to have established the city by spilling her blood on the ground when she landed there.
During the New Testament period, the city of Cyrene was significant as the place where Simon of Cyrene was compelled by the Roman soldiers to carry the cross of Jesus Christ on the Way of the Cross.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Cyrene, originally from ancient Greece and mentioned in the Bible, has seen a modern resurgence in various cultural contexts. On Instagram, users share photographs of their travels to the ancient city of Cyrene in modern-day Libya, often using the #ancestrytravel hashtag to connect their heritage to the location. On Reddit, there are active communities dedicated to ancient mythology and biblical stories where Cyrene is a popular topic of discussion. On Pinterest, users create boards featuring artwork, historical facts, and travel information related to Cyrene, contributing to a growing online collection of resources for those interested in the history and mythology of this ancient name.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Cyrene from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Cyrene - "Helper". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Cyrene symbolizes the burden and hardships borne by those who carry the cross of Christ. In the New Testament, Simon of Cyrene was compelled by the Roman soldiers to help Jesus carry His cross on the way to Calvary. This act of assistance, though unwilling, represents the shared suffering and sacrifice of all believers in Christ's mission.
